---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an enhancement or new feature
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement, feature-request
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem Statement

What problem does this solve? What pain points does it address?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like to see in detail. Include:
- User experience changes
- Backend/API changes required
- Database migrations (if any)
- New configurations or settings

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or specs about the feature request.

## Implementation Priority

- [ ] Critical (blocking for current phase)
- [ ] High (important for next phase)
- [ ] Medium (nice to have)
- [ ] Low (backlog)

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched the existing issues and feature requests
- [ ] I have provided a clear description of the feature
- [ ] I have explained the problem this solves
- [ ] I have considered alternative approaches
